supporting_observations.claim: At 13:46:26, julia.frost ran PowerShell to compress \\FILE-MAP-01\Shared\Clients into C:\Users\julia.frost\AppData\Local\Temp\c.zip; the archive file was created seconds later. This is suspicious collection and staging that closely coincides with the alerted transfer.
The archive command ran as julia.frost at medium integrity, with Explorer as its parent; the records do not show an administrative process launching it.

known_telemetry_limitations: The available records do not identify the destination, process, or payload for the alerted outbound transfer.
The records show archive creation, but do not establish what files it contained or whether it was successfully transferred.
The provided network records do not directly correlate the archive or PowerShell process with outbound bytes.
claims_not_established: That c.zip contained the data involved in the alerted transfer.
That the transfer reached an external recipient or was successful.
That julia.frost was unauthorized to access or archive the Clients share.
additional_evidence_needed: The network-monitoring flow or proxy record underlying the alert, including destination, byte counts, timestamps, and process attribution if available.
Endpoint evidence identifying the contents and subsequent handling of c.zip, including file access, deletion, or upload activity.
Business-owner or user confirmation of whether this archive and any related transfer were authorized.
unrelated_findings: Firefox attempted to connect to the unapproved sharefast-files.com service at 13:52:23, and the proxy denied the request. Investigate separately; the available records do not establish that this attempt was part of the alerted transfer. (T169-00173, T169-00174, T169-00175, T169-00176)

Google Drive File Stream started on WS-JFROST-01 at 13:40:46, and an earlier proxy record shows GoogleDriveFS traffic to clients4.google.com. The records do not show that it carried the alerted transfer; investigate the unapproved cloud-storage client separately. (T169-00004, T169-00125, T169-00126, T169-00128)

Domain authentication records show julia.frost activity attributed to WS-NKIM-01, while the corresponding network logon names WS-GLUND-01 as the workstation. Investigate this identity/host mismatch separately. (T169-00170, T169-00171, T169-00172)
